value.rationale: The source specifically names C10×K3 as exhibiting two nonzero free homology degrees and leaves torsion-freeness undecided. A complete integral homotopy classification for this same 30-vertex natural graph product supplies a nontrivial benchmark, excludes all Moore summands in this case, and is supported by a compact exact six-cycle Morse model. No uniform conjecture is claimed.
